name: My Boss Darling
original_name: 装乖诱他，我成了大佬的心尖宠
overview: To get revenge on her rival, Su Xi climbed into the bed of her rival's fabulously wealthy uncle, Xie Yanjing, and plucked this unattainable flower. Many speculated that Su Xi, a burden, would surely be skinned alive for provoking Mr. Xie. But in reality, the feared capital tycoon Xie Yanjing doted on and indulged Su Xi. When Su Xi was bullied, Xie Yanjing even declared, "I'm not here to uphold justice; I'm here to support Su Xi!"
